title: Length and vowels
summary: Read a line with fgets; walk a string up to its '\0'.
hints: fgets keeps the trailing '\n' in the buffer: do not count it.
A C string ends at the '\0' byte; loop until you reach it.
info: fgets(buf, size, stdin) reads at most size-1 chars and stops after a newline (which it stores). It returns NULL at end of input.
